cards.answer: Ambessa is a fighter and assassin who combines physical ability damage with empowered attacks that restore energy. Her ability-linked dashes let her reposition, but cannot cross terrain or occur while immobilized or grounded. Her ultimate blinks her to the farthest enemy champion in a chosen line.
cards.counterplay: Limit her access to attacks and use grounding or immobilization to restrict her dashes.

Active: Ambessa slashes with her twin drakehounds in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies hit.
Medarda Maxim: Ambessa's next basic attack gains range, bonus attack speed, deals bonus physical damage, and restores energy.

cards.answer: An attack or movement command during an ability's brief action lockout queues a dash toward that target or location afterward; the dash cannot cross terrain or occur while immobilized or grounded. Ability casts grant temporary Medarda Maxim stacks, up to three; basic attacks consume one each for extra range, attack speed, physical damage, and energy restoration. Ambessa sees her dash direction and destination indicator, and her empowered-attack pips are visible only to her player.
cards.counterplay: Deny attack access to limit energy restoration, and use grounding or immobilization to restrict repositioning.

citations.quote: During the lockout of Ambessa's abilities, inputting an attack or movement command causes her to dash to or towards the target or location, respectively, after the lockout ends.
This dash cannot pass through terrain.Ambessa cannot dash while immobilized or grounded.

facts.claim: An attack or movement command during an ability's brief action lockout queues a dash toward that target or location afterward; the dash cannot cross terrain or occur while immobilized or grounded.

Medarda Maxim: Ambessa's next basic attack gains range, bonus attack speed, deals bonus physical damage, and restores energy.

facts.claim: Ability casts grant temporary Medarda Maxim stacks, up to three; basic attacks consume one each for extra range, attack speed, physical damage, and energy restoration.

citations.quote: During Drakehound's Step, a visual indicator is visible to Ambessa displaying the eventual dash's direction and destination location.
The number of available attacks empowered by Medarda Maxim are visible as pips under Ambessa's health bar, only visible to the player.

facts.claim: Ambessa sees her dash direction and destination indicator, and her empowered-attack pips are visible only to her player.

cards.priority_reason: Her dashes and empowered attacks connect repositioning with energy recovery.
uncertainties: The frozen core describes both indicators as private, but the supplied evidence explicitly establishes exclusivity only for empowered-attack pips. Dash-indicator visibility is retained without inventing exclusivity.
Later commands can replace or cancel the queued dash input.
Immobilization or grounding during an ability lockout can cancel the buffered dash even if the control ends before the dash could begin.

cards.answer: Cunning Sweep is a directional slash that deals physical damage, increased at its outer edge. Hitting any enemy temporarily unlocks Sundering Slam.
cards.counterplay: Avoid the outer edge and track whether the slash hits an enemy to enable the follow-up.

citations.quote: Active: Ambessa slashes with her twin drakehounds in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies hit. The damage is increased against enemies hit by the outer edge.

facts.claim: Cunning Sweep is a directional slash that deals physical damage, increased at its outer edge.

citations.quote: If this hits at least one enemy, Ambessa can cast Sundering Slam within the next few seconds.

facts.claim: Hitting any enemy temporarily unlocks Sundering Slam.

cards.priority_reason: The outer edge increases damage, and a hit enables another cast.

cards.answer: After Cunning Sweep hits an enemy, Ambessa can briefly cast Sundering Slam. This follow-up deals physical damage in a line, with increased damage to the first enemy hit.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the line and avoid being its first target.

citations.quote: If this hits at least one enemy, Ambessa can cast Sundering Slam within the next few seconds.

facts.claim: After Cunning Sweep hits an enemy, Ambessa can briefly cast Sundering Slam.

citations.quote: Active: Ambessa slams her twin drakehounds in a line in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies hit. The damage is increased against the first enemy.

facts.claim: This follow-up deals physical damage in a line, with increased damage to the first enemy hit.

cards.priority_reason: First-target positioning changes the follow-up's damage threat.

cards.answer: Repudiation shields Ambessa as she braces, then smashes the ground to damage nearby enemies. If the shield absorbs champion, large-monster, or turret damage during bracing, the smash deals increased damage. Drakehound's Step can move the smash to her dash destination.
cards.counterplay: Avoid feeding damage into her bracing shield when possible, and leave space around her dash destination.

citations.quote: Ambessa gains a shield, briefly braces herself, and then slams the ground to damage nearby enemies.

facts.claim: Repudiation shields Ambessa as she braces, then smashes the ground to damage nearby enemies.

citations.quote: If the shield absorbs damage from a champion, large monster or turret during her bracing, the smash's damage is increased.

facts.claim: If the shield absorbs champion, large-monster, or turret damage during bracing, the smash deals increased damage.

citations.quote: If she performs Drakehound's Step's dash during Repudiation, she will smash the ground at her destination instead.

Ambessa will smash the ground at the end of Drakehound's Step's dash if she would finish bracing during it, and otherwise always smashes the ground from wherever she is at the end of the bracing time.

facts.claim: Drakehound's Step can move the smash to her dash destination.

cards.priority_reason: Damage absorbed during bracing can strengthen a repositionable retaliation.
uncertainties: The smash occurs at dash completion if bracing would finish during the dash; otherwise it occurs wherever Ambessa is when bracing ends.

cards.answer: Lacerate spins around Ambessa, dealing physical damage and briefly slowing nearby enemies. Using Drakehound's Step after the spin triggers another spin at the dash endpoint, repeating the damage and slow.
cards.counterplay: Create distance from both her initial position and her dash endpoint.

citations.quote: Active: Ambessa spins her twin drakehounds around her, dealing physical damage to enemies hit and slowing them briefly.

facts.claim: Lacerate spins around Ambessa, dealing physical damage and briefly slowing nearby enemies.

citations.quote: If Ambessa performs Drakehound's Step's dash after the spin, she will spin a second time upon arrival to apply the same effects.

facts.claim: Using Drakehound's Step after the spin triggers another spin at the dash endpoint, repeating the damage and slow.

cards.priority_reason: The dash repeats her nearby damage and slow.
uncertainties: The second spin still occurs if the dash is interrupted.

cards.answer: Public Execution passively grants armor penetration and healing from active-ability damage. After preparing a line strike, Ambessa blinks behind the farthest enemy champion in its area, suppresses them, then slams them for damage and a stun. During preparation and the target's suppression, she is immune to displacement and unable to act.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the strike's line and consider which ally is farthest within it.

citations.quote: Passive: Ambessa gains armor penetration and heals for a percentage of the damage dealt by her active abilities.

facts.claim: Public Execution passively grants armor penetration and healing from active-ability damage.

citations.quote: Active: Ambessa prepares a strike in a line in the target direction, then blinks behind the farthest enemy champion within the area and seizes them.
Ambessa blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival. She then slams the enemy into the ground where they take damage and are stunned.

facts.claim: After preparing a line strike, Ambessa blinks behind the farthest enemy champion in its area, suppresses them, then slams them for damage and a stun.

citations.quote: Ambessa is displacement immune and unable to act during the cast time and while the target is suppressed.
